sanitization: Text replaces the absolute repository path with <repo>. Only allowlisted fixture, runtime evidence, and PNG files are copied. Connection descriptors, tokens, profiles, native logs, and harness files are excluded. PNG files are unmodified fixture-only captures.
revisionNote: Execution used base commit 5294d56fb0d5f56a8a0f2feb8115579c5e995695 with uncommitted implementation. sourceHashes and compiledHashes identify the tested bytes; the implementation commit is required to match those source hashes. Do not reinterpret workingTreeDirty as false.
captureValidity: The final manifest capture status/file and events define accepted evidence. A raw file without an accepted manifest reference is not valid pause evidence.
